Learn moreSign in Comments 476 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Artemis II splashes down, completing historic moon mission 10KLikes489,633ViewsApr 102026 The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean near San Diego on Friday at 8:07pm ET, concluding a 694,481-mile roundtrip journey around the moon and back to Earth. The historic 10-day mission marked the first crewed flight to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972. The mission was a test flight for future missions that hope to return humans to the lunar surface. #artemis #artemisii #splashdown #nasa #cspan …...more ...more Show less How this was madeAuto-dubbedAudio tracks for some languages were automatically generated.
